props.name: Outdoor Aquatic Unit
props.about: The Outdoor Aquatic Unit (OAU) has laboratories, aquatic animal holding facilities and a water treatment building. It's maintained by Animal Care Services.

props.name: Hickman Building

props.name: David Strong Building

props.name: Halpern Centre For Graduate Students
props.about: The Halpern Centre for Graduate Students (GSC) is home of the Graduate Students’ Society, the Grad House Restaurant and Side Project Coffee.

props.name: The SUB
props.about: The Student Union Building (SUB) is home to the University of Victoria Students’ Society (UVSS). It has food outlets, businesses, services and advocacy groups.

props.about: The Engineering Office Wing (EOW) is home to the Faculty of Engineering and the departments of Biomedical, Mechanical, Software and Electrical and Computer Engineering.

props.name: Fine Arts Building
props.about: The Fine Arts Building is the home of the Faculty of Fine Arts and departments of Writing, Film Studies and Art History & Visual Studies.

props.about: The McPherson Library (LIB) contains UVic’s library holdings, the Mearns Centre for Learning, archives, special collections and the map library.

props.about: Bob Wright Centre (BWC) is home to the School of Earth and Ocean Sciences, the UVic telescope and the Canadian Centre for Climate Modelling and Analysis (CCCMA).

props.name: Continuing Studies Building
props.about: The Continuing Studies Building (CST) is home to the Division of Continuing Studies and the English Language Centre.

props.name: District Energy Plant

props.name: Child Care Complex
props.about: The Child Care Complex (CCC) provides child care for children over three years of age.

props.name: Čeqʷəŋín ʔéʔləŋ | Cheko’nien House
props.about: Čeqʷəŋín ʔéʔləŋ (Cheko’nien House) opened in September 2022 and contains student residences, a dining hall, study rooms, community kitchen and multi-purpose lounge.

props.name: Sŋéqə ʔéʔləŋ | Sngequ House
props.about: Sŋéqə ʔéʔləŋ (Sngequ House) features a mix of single-person dorm rooms and pod communities with shared kitchen and living spaces.  There are also lecture halls and conference facilities in the lower levels of the building.

props.name: Centre For Athletics, Recreation And Special Abilities
props.fullName: Centre For Athletics, Recreation And Special Abilities
props.about: Centre for Athletics, Recreation and Special Abilities (CARSA) is the home of the University of Victoria’s Vikes and UVic Athletics. It's UVic's primary gym.

props.name: Campus Community Garden
props.about: The Campus Community Garden offers free workshops, events, and a place for everyone to gather. CCG Staff and volunteers work together to grow fresh, organic fruits and vegetables for the UVIC community.

props.name: Glover Greenhouse
props.about: The Glover Greenhouse Facility (GGF) researches forest regeneration and biotechnology with the Centre for Forest Biology.

props.name: National Centre for Indigenous Laws
props.about: The Murray and Anne Fraser Building houses the Faculty of Law and the Diana M. Priestly Law Library. Its new National Centre for Indigenous Laws provides culturally appropriate spaces for learning, like classrooms, a wellness suite, among other spaces.
